findings.content: Instance display filtering lost upstream Ability compatibility for unbound installation candidates. Exact bindings remain visible; installation candidates now reuse compatibility checks.

The Registry accepts SDK cancel_actions with empty or null stop_actions, but the UI required a separate stop Ability. The UI now checks every declared action without rejecting the Registry-validated empty stop list.
The UI hid existing resume/recovery endpoints after a server restart or pause. Expose preparation resume and abandoned/deferred recovery while retaining backend admission checks.
The merged helper assumed catalogById existed in minimal store projections. Preserve upstream fallback behavior with optional lookup.

limitations: Tests and documentation follow the OCR default exclusion policy; unit/integration suites are reported independently.
No live robot execution, deployment, independent model review or administrator approval of main is claimed.
